# 04 Subgroup Analysis: Older Adults (Age ≥ 65)

Performs the geriatric subgroup evaluation described in Section 4.4. We recompute AUROC for key models on the subset of patients aged 65 and older, and generate Figure 2b.

import sys
sys.path.append("..")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
import joblib
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, roc_curve

from src.preprocess import load_and_split_data, preprocess_structured, preprocess_text, get_labels
from visualization.plot_roc import plot_roc_geriatric

with open("../config.yaml") as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
fig_dir = Path(config["output_paths"]["figures_dir"])
random_state = config["random_state"]

# Load data
train_df, val_df = load_and_split_data(
    config["data"]["raw_data_path"],
    training_cutoff_date=config["data"]["training_cutoff_date"],
    validation_start_date=config["data"]["validation_start_date"],
    random_state=random_state,
)
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, scaler = preprocess_structured(train_df, val_df)
train_texts, val_texts = preprocess_text(train_df, val_df)
y_train, y_val = get_labels(train_df, val_df)

# Geriatric subset
elder_mask = val_df["age"] >= 65
print(f"Geriatric subgroup size: {elder_mask.sum()} (total val: {len(val_df)})")
X_val_elder = X_val_raw[elder_mask]
texts_val_elder = val_texts[elder_mask].tolist()
y_val_elder = y_val[elder_mask]

# Load models
deeptriage = joblib.load("../outputs/models/deeptriage_cn.pkl")
vit_xgb = joblib.load("../outputs/models/vitals_only_xgb.pkl")
tabnet = joblib.load("../outputs/models/tabnet.zip")
val_scores = pd.read_csv("../outputs/models/clinical_scores_val.csv")

# Predict for subgroup
preds_elder = {}
preds_elder["DeepTriage-CN"] = deeptriage.predict_proba(texts_val_elder, X_val_elder)
preds_elder["TabNet"] = tabnet.predict_proba(X_val_elder)[:, 1]  # assuming TabNet wrapper
preds_elder["XGBoost (Vitals-only)"] = vit_xgb.predict_proba(X_val_elder)
preds_elder["NEWS2"] = val_scores.loc[elder_mask, "NEWS2"].values / 20.0
preds_elder["ESI"] = (6 - val_scores.loc[elder_mask, "ESI"].values) / 5.0
